body.name: Feasibility, uniqueness, and two-witness problems
body.construction: \(\textsc{K-Fiber}\) asks whether \(\mathcal F_K(\Sigma)\ne\varnothing\); \(\textsc{Unique-K-Fiber}\) asks whether \(|\mathcal F_K(\Sigma)|=1\); \(\textsc{Two-K-Fiber}\) returns two distinct tuples in \(\mathcal F_K(\Sigma)\) or certifies that fewer than two exist.
